from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot

def observe(seconds=0.0, video='frames', cameras=('head_camera','front_camera','left_camera','right_camera')):
    global obs
    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=cameras, seconds=seconds, video=video)
    print('OBS_META', json.dumps(obs.meta))
    if obs.meta.get('proprio'):
        print('PROPRIO', json.dumps(obs.meta['proprio']))
    for cam, frame in obs.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f'latest_{cam}.png')
    return obs

def ee(targets, video='mp4', note=''):
    global obs
    arr = np.asarray(targets, dtype=np.float32)
    if arr.ndim == 1:
        arr = arr[None, :]
    res = r.submit('ee_pose', arr, video=video, note=note)
    print('RESULT_META', json.dumps(res.meta))
    if res.proprio is not None:

    for cam, frame in res.last.items():

    return res
